subject: Important Update: Your Flight Itinerary
body: Dear [Recipient], We are writing to inform you that there has been a slight change in your upcoming flight itinerary. Your departure time has been rescheduled to 1 hour earlier due to air traffic congestion. Please arrive at the airport accordingly to avoid any inconvenience. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding in this matter. Thank you, The Travel Airlines Team
